purpose: Test whether pre-existing market regime separates continuation from failure after symmetric MA7 close crosses; this is not an MA parameter optimization.

data.source_union_reason: The repository preserves immutable legacy API partitions. Restricting to Vision alone omits BTC and other core contracts. ETH has controlled cross-source overlap, so the selected union prefers Binance Vision on identical symbol-timestamp keys and uses API rows only where Vision is absent.
data.controlled_overlap_policy: partition by canonical symbol and timestamp; prefer binance_vision_kline_monthly, then binance_futures_kline_api; fail on duplicates within either source
data.historical_universe: all canonical USDT-style perpetual symbols present in the official Binance Vision monthly archive, including contracts absent from current exchangeInfo
data.listing_time_proxy: first observed official archive bar per canonical contract
data.duplicate_policy: fail within source; deterministic Vision-over-API priority for cross-source overlap; selected union must be unique
data.gap_policy: a signal and its lookback/forward path are valid only when the required UTC daily grid is contiguous

event.costs: not applied because this is a close-to-close conditional event study, not an executable strategy backtest

regime.atr14: Wilder true range arithmetic mean over 14 complete UTC days
regime.rv20: sample standard deviation of 20 daily log returns times sqrt(365)
regime.rv_percentile: within-contract percentile rank of RV20[t] among the 252 RV20 observations ending at t

binning.normalized_slope: global pooled quintile cut points computed from all eligible daily regime observations, not from event outcomes
binning.er20: global pooled quintile cut points computed from all eligible daily regime observations, not from event outcomes
binning.edge_reuse: MA7 edges are frozen and reused unchanged for MA5 and MA10 robustness

statistics.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg within each direction, horizon, and return metric across the 125 three-way cells

btc_market_phase.bull: BTC close > BTC SMA200 and BTC 30-day return > 0
btc_market_phase.bear: BTC close < BTC SMA200 and BTC 30-day return < 0

liquidity_segment.major: top 20 eligible contracts by point-in-time measure on each event date

decision_boundary.interpretation: A useful regime surface must be economically separated, reasonably monotone or smooth, and repeat across time, direction, liquidity segment, and MA5/7/10 without selecting a winner after seeing results.
